evidence_context.dls_descriptor: product no-auth identity; default runtime workspace; empty knowledge filters
evidence_context.profile: q1 deterministic; seed budget 100; RRF k=60; documentary-prov-o v1

sampling_methodology.design: Predeclared stratified sample across documentary form families, ordered before measurement.
sampling_methodology.anti_cherry_picking: Includes exact/small, medium, broad, and deliberately generic pathological candidates; no case is selected from an observed closure size in this campaign.
sampling_methodology.order: Round-robin across entity, correspondence, incident, contract, chronology, project, multi-party, and small-component forms; broad pathological candidates are retained at the end as safety stressors.

documentary_target_validation_defaults.diagnostic_guard_rationale: Production remains max_entities=500. The benchmark-only 1000 entity guard isolates hard_documents through 750 with 33% headroom for approximately one entity per source occurrence; max_depth remains 8 and traversal batch size remains unchanged.
